description: This file defines a controller class 'jjwg_AreasController' that extends 'SugarController'. It contains methods to handle actions related to editing and viewing maps associated with areas, retrieving module info, polygons, and area locations.

classes.name: jjwg_AreasController
classes.description: Controller class for managing area-related map views, extending the SugarController base class, and including methods for editing and displaying area maps.

methods.name: action_area_edit_map
methods.description: Sets up the view to edit an area map and retrieves the map's polygon and location data based on a provided ID.

methods.name: action_area_detail_map
methods.description: Sets up the view to display the details of an area map and retrieves the map's polygon and location data based on a provided ID.
